description: This file contains a function 'choose_obs_subj_behav_category' that creates a GUI window for selecting subjects, behaviors, and time intervals in a behavioral observation software called BORIS. It manages user interactions, updates GUI elements, and returns a dictionary with the selected parameters.

classes.name: Param_panel
classes.description: A class representing the parameter selection GUI window in BORIS.

methods.name: choose_obs_subj_behav_category
methods.description: Creates and manages a GUI window for selecting subjects, behaviors, and time intervals in BORIS, returning a dictionary of user selections.
